task_description: @Super-Admin Fix dispatch-subagent.js line 658: ReferenceError '_dispatch is not defined' — root cause is backtick template literal nesting conflict. The line contains markdown backticks `.task_temp/_dispatch/...` inside a JavaScript template literal (outer backticks). The inner backticks break the template literal, causing _dispatch to be parsed as a JS variable expression. Fix: change inner backticks to single quotes or escape properly.
